[[custom-tools]]
== Pons & Panic Attack

*`custom-tools` · integration · tool-dependent*

Execute pons scan and panic-attack assail with explicit unavailable-tool outcomes.

*Assurance boundary:* Install both tools first; not in default audit. Missing tools are not a passing scan.
